name: Lisa Earhart
source:
She is an oddball who came to the school because she wanted to be able to use her unused powers to the fullest (fight monsters with all her might). She is friendly and has the special skill of becoming friends with everyone she meets. Her defining characteristic is that she always ends her sentences with "ssu".

She has a tomboyish, energetic appearance. Although she isn't particularly well-proportioned, her vulnerability and healthy sexiness are what make her so appealing.

Her specialty is, of course, combat. With incredible strength that belies her small physique, she can effortlessly swing around huge axes and maces. But her greatest weapon may still be her fists.
